t.zh: 晨星和昏星是不是同一颗星？要说两样东西相等，先要声明相等。
t.en: Are the Morning Star and the Evening Star one star? To say two things are equal, equality has to be declared first.

after.zh: 这条引入规则就是自反律；相等的消去规则是等量代换。
after.en: This introduction rule is reflexivity; the elimination rule of equality is substitution.

brief.zh: 需求：任何东西都等于它自己；凭空证不出两个不同名字相等。写出「相等」的声明。
brief.en: Requirement: everything equals itself; two different names cannot be proved equal from nothing. Write the declaration of equality.

hint.zh: 凭空证得出的「s = t」，两边有什么共同之处？
hint.en: What do the two sides of an “s = t” proved from nothing have in common?
